faqs.question: How does the process work?
faqs.answer: You share your medical information, our team reviews it, and we help you with doctor and hospital options, appointments, visa documents and travel planning.

faqs.question: Do you provide medical advice?
faqs.answer: No. We coordinate care and paperwork. Medical advice comes only from licensed doctors.

faqs.question: Are my documents safe?
faqs.answer: Your documents are stored privately and only shared with staff who need them to help you. Every access is recorded.
